title: Immediate Implant Placement with the Socket Shield Technique: A Case Report with Digital Planning and Guided Surgery
authors: Massola Filho, F. F., Cambiaghi, L., Quevedo, H. M. de, Franco, A. G., Campos, Édson A. de, Gomes, C. R. F., & Moreira, G. Revista CPAQV - Centro De Pesquisas Avançadas Em Qualidade De Vida 2025 Feb 10, 17(1), 11.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The combination of the socket shield technique, digital planning, and guided surgery contributes to superior esthetic and functional results in immediate implant placement. This approach minimizes alveolar ridge resorption and optimizes long-term peri-implant tissue stability” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
